en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 0.69 per cent higher at 23,093
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rebounded on Friday, with the benchmark rising 158 points on turnover of about HK$250 billion after earlier fluctuations.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 158.69 points, or 0.69 per cent, higher at 23,093.37 on Friday, according to market data. Full-day turnover reached about HK$249.8 billion.

The Hang Seng Tech Index gained 2.05 per cent to 3,871.66, while the China Enterprises Index rose 0.87 per cent to 7,756.25. The benchmark had dipped to a session low near 22,804 before recovering in the afternoon.
RTHK reported that Asian shares were mostly higher as markets rebounded from early losses. The Hang Seng Index still posted a weekly decline of about 4.5 per cent.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收報23093點 升0.69%
zh.dek: 港股周五反彈，恒指升158點，全日成交約2498億元，早段曾波動後回升。
body: 恒生指數周五收報23093.37點，升158.69點或0.69%。全日成交額約2498億元。
恒生科技指數升2.05%至3871.66點，國企指數升0.87%至7756.25點。指數早段曾低見約22804點，午後回升。
港台報道，亞洲股市大多回升，從早段跌幅中反彈。恒指本周累計仍跌約4.5%。
